translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Bab Dummad Burba Nued nonikid
Pentecostés-Iba nonigu, bela Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad danakwaa na bukwa-gusmalad.
Ukiar nibneggi burwa-binnasur-goleyob gornonikid, bela emar-bukwadgi eunonikid.
Degi daklealid ibmar soo-ditismakedyob ditismakdegu, belagwapa dulemar-irba signonikid.
Belagwapa Bab Dummad Burba Nued bela-bela Jesúsba-nanaimaladgi ubononigu, gangudmalad, gaya akar-akar sunmakdemalad, ar igi Bab Dummad Burba Nued ega sogedba, aba sunmakdemalad.
Deunni bela Judiomar-we-napneg-naid-ugakse-bukmalad nue-islikwaa-nanadimaladi Jerusalénse nonigusmalad, iba dakegar.

A-dulemar ibmar binnasur gote itoarmargu, bela danar ambikunonimalad. Agine, geger Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-dakdemalad, ar ade dule-gaya-baid-baid-sunmakmalad itoarmalad Jesúsba-nanaimalad emar sunnaa sunmakmala.
Degisoggu, bela geger dakdemarsundo, degi, aku-itomarbarsundo, wede igidbarsunna. Degisoggu, na sokarmarsundo: “Be dake, ¿wemarde sunmakbukmaladde Galilea-dorgansursi?
¿Ibiga wemarde nabir anmar na-gin-gwalulesad-gaya sunmakmarsunna?
“Anmardi Partia-dorgan, Media-dorgan, Elam-dorgan, degi, anmar Mesopotamiagi-bukwamalad, Judeaginmalad, Capadociaginmalad, Pontoginmalad, degi, Asiaginmalad,
Frigiaginmalad, degi, Panfiliaginmalad, agi, Egiptoginmalad, agi, Libia-dor-Cireneginmalad, degi, Roma-akar-danimalad, Judiomar, degi, Judio-igarba-dogsamalad,
degi, Cretaginmalad, Arabiaginmalad. Emide wemar-Galilea-dorgan, nabir anmar-gayaba Bab Dummad ibmar-geger-daklemalad imaksadgi sunmakmargu.”
Degisoggu, belagwapa geger dakmalad, degi, aku itomarbalid, aga na muchub-muchub ega sokarmarsunnad: “¿Wede igid barsunna, gaya akar-akar sunmakmargu?”
Degisoggu, abala Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimaladgi dododmar, sogdemarsun: “Wemardi mummu-bukwamalad.”
Pedro Bab Burba Nuedgi sunmaksad

Degi Pedro na e-ambe-gakagwensakad-gwichid-abargi gwichimoga, binnasur sunmakde, sogded: “Judea-dorgan, degi, bela bemar-Jerusalén-neggweburgi-bukwamalad, nue be an-itomalo. An bemarga sogodo, wede ibi nue obarsunna.
We-dulemar bemar mummuye bimaladi, mummusurmalad, ar amba neg wagdarad. ¿Dulemar neg-wagdar mungudii bemar dakdisi? Degisoggu, noar be sogmalad.
“Ar wemar bemar dakedi, bato Joel, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged sogsa-gusad:

content.text: abe, soo, degine, waa booyobi bela neg-gaoed.
deyob neg guoed, dummarba neg degi-oyolegoed.
Ar ade doa-dule, Bab Dummadse abonoleged egisbiele,

content: Pedro sogdebar: “Israel-dorgan, we an-bemarga-ibmar-sogoedi nue baritomalo: Jesús Nazaret-dola, bemardi nue wismalad, bemar-abargi Bab-Dummad-nuggi ibmar-dakledisurmaladi, ibmar-geger-daklemalad-wilubgan oyosad, ar a bemar bela-wisi bukwamalad, adi bemar dakega, na doa-dule gue.
Ar igi Bab Dummad na iduar igar-mesisadgii, bemarga Jesús uklenonigu, bemar gasmargu, dule-iskanamar bemar-bendaksadba nakrusgi be Jesús-bioksamalad, oburgwegar.
“Degi-inigwele, Bab Dummaddi Jesús-odulosad, burgwed-nunmaked-abargi ogwichisad, ar ade burgwed Jesúsgi geg obined.
A-ular, David Bab Dummadgi wegi-sogsa-gusad:

content.text: adi mer ibmar dobee an itogegar.
Aga uangi an-san-burba gwen be oyogsaosulid,
Be anga igar-nuegan dula-saila gudigued oyosad,
degi, be anba gudidbali weligwar an itoged.”

content: Pedro sogdebar: “Gwenadgan, bela anmar wisid, anmar-dad-David-nugad burgwisad, degine, diglesad, agi e-neg-uan emi amba anmar-abargi daklediid. Degisoggu, David na e-sangi sunmaksasurdo.
“Ar David Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbegedsoggu, nue wissunnad, igi Bab Dummad ega sogsagusa, gege-bar-osuloged-igargi ega sogsagu:

Degisoggu, bato daknaiyobi, David sogsad Cristo gannar durguoedgi. David deun weyob sogsa-gusad: ‘Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-bega-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule neg-uangi sadegu mai-guosulid, degine, agi nungumai-guosurbalid.’
“A-Jesús-sunnad, Bab Dummad gannar odulosad. Jesús-gannar-durgusad, bela anmar daksamalad.

Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-argan-nuedsik dummadga Jesús sigidapsunnad, degi, Bab Dummad Burba Nued ukoye sogsadi Jesúsga uklessunnad, geb A-Burba-Nued, Jesús anmarga uknaimogad. A-igar bemar daksamaladi, degi, itosmaladi, Jesúsgi bela danikid.
Ar ade David nibnegse nakwissulid, degite David-sunnad sogbalid:

“Degisoggu, bela bemar-Israel-dorgan, nue itomarsun, napira an bemarga sogmalad, we Jesús bemar nakrusgine-oburgwismaladi, a-Jesús-sunnadi Bab Dummad Dule-Dummadga imaksad, degi, Cristoga imaksabalid.”
Dulemar-Pedro-itobukmalad deyob Pedro soge itosmargu, nue gwagegi bukib itodmalad. Pedrose, degi, baigan-Jesús-nuggi-barmilearmaladse egichiarmarsunnad: —Degite gwenadgan, ¿igi anmar saer nabirsunna?

Pedro, abin-imakded: —Be-iskudiidga na be wargwen-wargwen bukib binsamar, degi, egi be bangumar, geb degi Bab Dummadse be dagmar, degi, Bab-Dummad-digi-ogleged-igar be Jesucristo-nuggi imakmarsun, adi Bab Dummad be-iskudiid bemarga eliegar, geb adi E-Burba-Nued bemarga ukegar.
“Ar Bab Dummad E-Burba-Nued bemarga ukoye sogsadi, ar bemarga ukegalad, degi, be-mimmiganga, degi, dulemar-dikasur-Bab-Dummadgi-gudimaladga, ar doa-dulemarse Dummad, anmar-Bab-Dummad na gorbiedse.”

Deyob Pedro suibaksaar Jesús-igargi sunmakgwisgu, aimarga binsaed-nued-ukgwichi sogdebar: “Bemar we-dulemar-iskudididgi be bangumarsun, adi we-dulemar-iskanaba mer sabsur Bab Dummadse bemar odurdaklemalagar.”
Dulemar Pedro-ibmar-sogsadba igar imaksamaladi, Bab-Jesús-digi-ogleged-igar imaksamarsunnad. Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimaladba a-ibagi milipaa-gubin eba nagusmalad.

Amar unnila Bab-Jesús-nuggi-barmilesmalad-e-odurdakedba nanabukwa-gusmalad. Degi, bulakwaa na muchub-muchub bendakbukwa, Bab Dummadse gorbukwa, degi, Bab-Jesús-burgwisad insaegala danakwaa na madu gunbukwa-gusmalad.
Gebe-Bab-Jesúsba-nagusmalad e-nanasmalad
Bela geger Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-dakbukwa-gusmalad, ar ade Jesús-nuggi-barmilesmalad bukidar ibmar-geger-daklemalad, degine, ibmar-wilubgan-imakledisurmalad imakbukwa-gusmalad.
Bela Bab-Jesúsgi-bensurmalad danakwaa na bipirmakdii-guarmalad, degi, e-ibmar-nikamaladi muchub-muchub na ega uknanai-guarmarbalid.
Nainu-nikamalad na uknanai-guarmalad, degi, ibmar bela uknanai-guarmalad, geb a-mani na mimminanai-guarmalad, na ibmar abegedba.

Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad bane-bane Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi na ambikubimaladba ambikubukwa, degi, na muchub-muchub neg-irba na madu mimmibukwa, weligwaledgi, danakwaa na gwagegi yeer-itogedgi na mas gunbukwa-gusmalad.
Amar Bab-Dummad-nug ogannobukwa, degi, dulemar, nabir Bab-Jesúsba-nanaimalad-dakbukwa-gusmalad. Degine, Bab Dummad bane-bane dulemar-gwage-abonolesmalad ega omelomai-gusad.
